name: The Origami Phoenix Rising
description: A magnificent phoenix folded from ancient origami paper that unfolds its wings to reveal galaxies within each feather.
prompt: A stunning phoenix crafted entirely from ancient origami paper, its wings spread wide as it rises from a mountain of crumpled letters and forgotten wishes. Each feather contains swirling galaxies, nebulae, and star clusters visible through the semi-transparent paper. Golden edges glow with inner fire while the body shimmers with iridescent scales made of folded metallic foil. Cherry blossom petals spiral upward in the phoenix's wake. Epic fantasy scene, cosmic detail, symbolic rebirth imagery.
caption: From folded paper rises a bird whose wings hold entire universes within each feather... 🦋🌌
